tag: 詢問社區花園的菜圃名額

level.why: 對話使用同義換句，需由候補名單推論花園搶手，屬中級。

dialogue.t: Hi, I'd like to know how to get a plot in the community garden.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想知道怎麼取得社區花園的一塊菜圃。

dialogue.t: We have a waiting list right now, but a few spaces will open up in April.
dialogue.zh: 目前有候補名單，不過四月會空出幾個名額。

dialogue.t: How much does it cost, and do I need to bring my own tools?
dialogue.zh: 費用多少？我需要自備工具嗎？

dialogue.t: It's thirty dollars a season. Tools are shared, but you'll need to buy your own seeds.
dialogue.zh: 一季三十美元。工具是共用的，但種子要自己買。

dialogue.t: That's reasonable. Can I visit the garden first, to see which spots get the most sun?
dialogue.zh: 很合理。我可以先去看看哪些位置日照最多嗎？

dialogue.t: Of course. Come this Saturday morning, and one of our volunteers will walk you around.
dialogue.zh: 當然。這週六早上過來，會有一位志工帶你參觀。

dialogue.t: Wonderful. Please put me on the list, and I'll bring my neighbor along too.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。請把我列入名單，我也會帶鄰居一起去。

q.t: Why is the woman talking to the man?
q.zh: 女士為什麼和男士說話？

choices.t: To request a space in a garden
choices.zh: 為了申請花園裡的一塊地
choices.why: 她想知道如何取得社區花園的菜圃。

choices.t: To sign up for a gardening class
choices.why: 沒有提到課程。
志工是男士提到的帶路人員，她不是要當志工。
工具是共用的，不是她來的目的。

q.t: What can be inferred about the community garden?
q.zh: 關於社區花園可以推論出什麼？

choices.why: 四月是空出名額的時間，花園並未關閉。

choices.t: The fees are too high for most people.
choices.why: 女士覺得費用合理。

choices.zh: 許多人想要那裡的菜圃。
choices.why: 有候補名單，表示需求大於名額。
工具是共用的。

q.t: What must the woman buy on her own?

choices.why: 工具是共用的，不用自備。
沒有提到肥料。
沒有提到地圖。
男士說種子要自己買。

tag: 為青少年挑選夏季戶外課程

level.why: 需先排除與練球衝突的日子再對照預算與課表，並理解說話意圖，屬中級偏上。

dialogue.t: Hello, I'm looking for an outdoor activity for my son this summer. He's fifteen.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想為兒子找這個夏天的戶外活動。他十五歲。

dialogue.t: We have several programs. Do you prefer weekdays or weekends?
dialogue.zh: 我們有幾個課程。你偏好平日還是週末？

dialogue.t: Weekday evenings, please. He has soccer practice on Tuesdays and Thursdays, though.
dialogue.zh: 請給我平日晚上的。不過他星期二和星期四要練足球。

dialogue.t: I see. And is there a price range you'd like to stay within?
dialogue.zh: 了解。還有你想控制在哪個價格範圍內嗎？

dialogue.t: I'd rather not pay more than forty dollars for the whole program.
dialogue.zh: 整個課程我不想付超過四十美元。

dialogue.t: Then here's our schedule. Take it home and talk it over with your son.
dialogue.zh: 那這是我們的課表。帶回家和你兒子討論一下。

dialogue.t: Thank you. I'll discuss the options with him tonight and call you back to register.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你。我今晚會和他討論，再打電話給你報名。

q.t: Why does the woman say, "He has soccer practice on Tuesdays and Thursdays, though"?
q.zh: 女士為什麼說「不過他星期二和星期四要練足球」？

choices.t: To request a class on Tuesdays
choices.why: 星期二正是他沒空的日子。

choices.t: To show which days her son is unavailable
choices.why: 她先要平日晚上，再用 though 排除這兩天。

choices.t: To say her son dislikes weekends
choices.why: 她沒有談週末的好惡。
費用是後面才談的。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which activity will the son most likely join?
q.zh: 請看圖表。兒子最可能參加哪項活動？

choices.why: 費用符合，但在星期四，與練球衝突。
在星期二且 $45，兩項都不符。
在星期六早上，不是平日晚上。
平日晚上、不在星期二四、四十美元以內，只有星期三 $30 的 Trail Running 符合。

q.t: What will the woman most likely do next?
q.zh: 女士接下來最可能做什麼？

choices.t: Talk with her son before signing up
choices.why: 她說今晚會和他討論再回電報名。
是男士把課表給她。
四十美元是預算上限，不是今天要付的。
沒有提到她要週六去。

tag: 營位被洪水影響改換山丘營位

level.why: 營位更動的原因需靠同義換句理解，並推論先生行動不便。

dialogue.t: Good morning. Are you checking in at Pinecrest Campground, or are you just visiting for the day?
dialogue.zh: 早安。你們是要在松林露營區入住，還是只來玩一天？

dialogue.t: Checking in. We reserved a site near the river for three nights.
dialogue.zh: 要入住。我們訂了河邊的營位三晚。

dialogue.t: I'm sorry, but that area is closed after yesterday's flooding. I can offer you a spot on the hill instead.
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉，那一區在昨天淹水後關閉了。我可以改給你們山丘上的營位。

dialogue.t: How far is the hill from the washrooms? My husband has a bad knee.
dialogue.zh: 山丘離洗手間多遠？我先生膝蓋不好。

dialogue.t: About a two-minute walk on a flat path. Campfires are allowed, but only until ten o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 走平坦的路大約兩分鐘。可以升營火，但只到十點。

dialogue.t: That sounds fine. Will we pay the same price, even though there's no view of the river?
dialogue.zh: 聽起來可以。即使看不到河景，我們付的價錢還是一樣嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, but I'll include two bundles of firewood to make up for it.
dialogue.zh: 是的，但我會附上兩綑柴火作為補償。

q.t: What problem does the man describe?

choices.t: The campground has no space for visitors.
choices.zh: 露營區沒有空位給訪客。
choices.why: 他還能提供山丘營位。

choices.t: The campsite the woman wanted is unavailable.
choices.zh: 女士想要的營位無法使用。
choices.why: 河邊營位因淹水而關閉。

choices.t: The hill is too far from the river.
choices.why: 距離並不是問題，問題是河邊關閉。

choices.t: The woman arrived on the wrong day.
choices.why: 沒有提到日期錯誤。

q.t: What can be inferred about the woman's husband?
q.zh: 關於女士的先生可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: He may find long walks difficult.
choices.why: 她因先生膝蓋不好而詢問步行距離。

choices.t: He wants a spot nearer the river.
choices.zh: 他想要更靠近河的營位。
choices.why: 她擔心的是離洗手間的距離，並不要河邊。

choices.t: He will not join the camping trip.
choices.why: 沒有這樣的暗示。

choices.t: He has asked for a refund.
choices.why: 她問的是價格是否相同，且不是他問的。

q.t: What is allowed until ten o'clock?
q.zh: 到十點為止可以做什麼？

choices.why: 沒有提到游泳。
沒有提到音樂。
洗手間只是提到距離，沒有時間限制。
男士說營火可以升，但只到十點。
